cut_items.item: Provides a decorator form (retrying) for applying retry to functions, with usage example
Warns that a timeout doesn't reveal whether the first call succeeded; suggests using an idempotency key for payments/writes
Advises keeping max_attempts times max_delay within the overall time budget
Explains why jitter matters (thundering herd / synchronized retry spikes) in a dedicated section
Decorator form `retrying` with functools.wraps for convenient use

Caveat that a timeout doesn't tell you whether the first call succeeded, and a recommendation to use an idempotency key for payments/writes
Advice to keep max_attempts × max_delay within the overall time budget

Notes that the last exception is re-raised with its original traceback
